Daily use gently removes wax, dirt, and buildup before they can contribute to ear problems. Here's what you'll typically notice in your pet:

Week 1 — ears look cleaner, with less visible wax and debris after each wipe.

Week 2 — less buildup returns between cleanings, and ears stay fresher for longer.

Every wipe comes away with the wax, dirt, and debris you've just removed — visible proof it's lifting buildup from the ear, not simply pushing it around.

settings.title: Your dog's ears tell a story you can't ignore

settings.text:
A yeasty smell, brown wax, or constant head shaking—these may seem like minor problems.

But beneath the surface, they can quickly turn into something much worse.

Moisture and bacteria build up in your dog's ears every day. Without cleaning, your dog risks painful infections, inflammation, and costly vet bills.

It hurts to think about, but the fact is:

Paper towels and cotton pads can push bacteria deeper. Ear drops create stress and mess.

You shouldn't have to worry every time you check your dog's ears.

That's why we—together with veterinarians—created EarWipes – a simple, gentle routine that both cleans and protects.

settings.caption: See how easy it is – completely stress-free

settings.text:
EarWipes does more than just wipe away dirt.

They are developed to clean deeply – so that bacteria don't get a foothold.

By removing wax and debris it reduces the risk of odor, inflammation and painful infections.

And thanks to the gentle formula, they are comfortable even for sensitive ears.

The result? Clean, healthy ears and a dog that doesn't need to scratch.

settings.title: The scratching finally stopped
settings.text: My Golden has been digging at his ears for MONTHS. Like every few minutes, constantly. I tried wiping them with wet paper towels, bought those expensive ear drops from the pet store - he hated those and would literally hide under the bed when he saw me coming. Started using these wipes about 2 weeks ago and the scratching is almost completely gone. The smell disappeared too which is honestly the best part because his face used to reek. He just sits there now, doesn't even try to pull away.

settings.title: Haven't been to the vet in 5 months
settings.text: My Cocker gets ear infections constantly. Like clockwork every 2-3 months. Every single time it's $250+ at the vet, antibiotics, the whole thing. I was getting desperate honestly. Started cleaning his ears with these twice a week after his groomer recommended them. It's been 5 months and NO infections. My vet actually commented on how good his ears looked at his last checkup. I'm not even kidding when I say these have saved me probably $500 this year alone.
settings.author: Michael T., 52 | Cocker Spaniel owner - 2025-08-22

settings.title: Game changer for my water-obsessed Lab
settings.text: My Lab is obsessed with water. Pool, lake, doesn't matter - he's in it. But then his ears would get this gross yeasty smell within like 2 days. I was using those liquid ear cleaners and it was a whole wrestling match every time. Total nightmare. These wipes are so much easier - I just do it right after he swims while he's still tired. Takes maybe a minute for both ears. The smell doesn't come back anymore and his ears stay dry. Honestly wish I'd found these years ago.
settings.author: Sarah K., 39 | Labrador owner - 2025-10-05

settings.title: First thing that doesn't make her ears worse
settings.text: My Poodle's ears are SO sensitive. Everything I tried made them red and angry looking. Even the "gentle" stuff from the vet. She'd shake her head for hours after. These don't seem to bother her at all. I can actually see the brown gunk on the wipe when I'm done which is kinda gross but also you know it's actually working? Her ears are finally that healthy pink color instead of inflamed. I use them maybe 3 times a week and it keeps everything under control.
settings.author: Linda M., 61 | Poodle owner - 2025-07-18

settings.title: Rescue with chronic ear issues - finally under control
settings.text: Adopted a Beagle from the shelter who had really bad ear problems. They told me it would probably be an ongoing thing, just part of having a Beagle. Started cleaning her ears with these right away, just a couple times a week. Six months later and we haven't had a single infection. Not one. The vet was honestly surprised because apparently her breed is prone to it. Super easy to use and she doesn't fight me on it. Way better than dealing with vet visits every other month.
